author: BioCentury
title: Biotech stocks ride tech rally
text: Biotech stocks ride tech rally 3:26 PM Print PDF Biotech indexes ended the week on a positive note but it wasn’t enough to salvage the week. The NASDAQ Biotechnology Index (NBI), SPDR S&P Biotech ETF (XBI), BioCentury 100 and NYSE Arca Biotechnology Index (BTK) each lost about 5% on the week, despite gaining about 2% Friday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, Standard & Poor’s 500 index and NASDAQ Composite each shed about 4% for the week. Each index climbed at least 1% Friday, with the NASDAQ Composite gaining 2%. Biotech indexes and the broader markets were routed mid-week, with losses of 3-4% on Wednesday (see "Biotech Slides with Broader Market" ). Wednesday's sell-off particularly affected large tech stocks, such as Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) and Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN). Apple was able to recover with a 4% gain on Friday, closing the week out flat. Amazon also gained 4% on Friday, but still finished down 5% for the week. User Sign in
